result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with mixed-use buildings and trolley tracks embedded in the roadway. Pedestrian infrastructure includes marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals, but the wide crossing distance and sightline obstructions from parked cars reduce overall safety.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Steel tracks embedded in the asphalt can be slippery when wet and create a tripping hazard for pedestrians crossing the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway through the intersection.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the street increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a refuge island.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sight lines.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image depicts a typical urban intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure, including sidewalks, a marked zebra crosswalk, and pedestrian signals. While functional, the environment lacks modern safety enhancements like curb extensions or high-visibility markings, and sight lines are partially obstructed by parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the side street may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb of the side street, adjacent to the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Faded pavement markings
hazards.description: The zebra crosswalk and lane markings are worn, reducing their visibility and effectiveness in guiding traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the side street and within the main intersection area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at the corners to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Refresh and upgrade the crosswalk markings to a high-visibility continental pattern to increase driver awareness.

result.summary: The environment features continuous sidewalks but lacks essential crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals at the signalized intersection. The presence of embedded trolley tracks and degraded pavement creates additional hazards for pedestrians and other vulnerable road users.

hazards.name: Embedded Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks in the roadway can be slippery when wet and present a tripping hazard or a risk for bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Running longitudinally down the center of the roadway

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection is controlled by a traffic light but lacks any painted crosswalks, leaving pedestrians unprotected and less visible to drivers.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven asphalt surfaces near the tracks and curb line.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image depicts an urban intersection adjacent to a hospital facility with marked zebra crosswalks and signalized traffic control. While sidewalks are present, they are significantly narrowed and obstructed by utility poles and a large institutional sign at the corner, which also limits sightlines.

hazards.description: The large red hospital sign blocks sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven surfaces on the sidewalk and roadway near the crossing.
